name: PDZ
fix_description: In burnToHolder, replace uniswapRouter.getAmountsOut() (spot price) with a TWAP oracle for calculating deserved rewards. The current implementation uses manipulable AMM spot price, allowing attackers to inflate rewards via flash loan price manipulation.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, straightforward flash-loan price manipulation exploit against a reward calculation that trusts router spot pricing. The attack is only a few steps with minimal protocol-specific complexity and the PoC is compact, so an experienced auditor could likely reproduce it quickly.
